data.description:
## Problem

CI 'Gerrit Verified Gate' pytest on ubuntu-latest/py3.11 intermittently fails with a worker crash, blocking otherwise-green changes:

    [gw3] node down: Not properly terminated
    worker 'gw3' crashed while running 'tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py::test_matching_guard_is_accepted'
    1 failed, 11495 passed, 66 skipped

- py3.11 ONLY - py3.12/py3.13/macos-py3.13 pass on the same tree.
- Nondeterministic - crashed on two consecutive runs of change 1552 (31282246724, 31283024535) yet passed green in a concurrent run (31283137439) on the same base main 2d440ad668. Also bit epic cf3c change 0289 PS4.
- It is a worker-process death ('node down'), not an assertion failure - likely a fastapi TestClient + opcert_service.jobs (subprocess/thread/signal) interaction under xdist on py3.11.

## Impact

A worker crash on an unrelated test forces repeated recheck cycles (~15 min each) to land any change, including docs-only ones. A CI-reliability tax, not a product bug.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Root-cause the gw3 crash on py3.11 for test_matching_guard_is_accepted (repro under xdist; isolate the subprocess/signal/threading interaction).
- [ ] Make the opcert-service test robust on py3.11 (or serialize it off xdist on 3.11) so the Verified py3.11 lane is deterministically green.
- [ ] No regression on py3.12/py3.13/macos.

Discovered while landing docs story b014 (epic cf3c); unrelated to that change.
data.title: py3.11 xdist worker crash: opcert test_matching_guard_is_accepted
